title: Holo4 agents work across screens, code, APIs and MCP tools
friendlyTitle: Holo4 can use screens, code and software tools together
summary: H Company has released Holo4 in 27B dense and 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts versions, plus Holotron4 Nano. The models can combine GUI actions, code execution, APIs and MCP tools, and the company has published weights, benchmark trajectories and a dataset for inspection.
friendlySummary: H Company’s new open models can click and type, run code, and call APIs or MCP tools. The company also shared model files and step-by-step benchmark records.
whyItMatters: A single agent that can choose between a screen and a structured interface better reflects real business work than a GUI-only system. Open trajectories make it easier to examine failures, though benchmark comparisons still use different harnesses and task subsets.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Real tasks often move between several kinds of software. The shared records help developers check how the agent reached a result instead of trusting only a score.
